title: Set up Claude Code with Set-up Info
done: That is it: paste the text once, and again whenever the app says the install is out of date.

steps.caption: Set-up Info is in the garnet-scoping menu on macOS, and in the Help menu on Ubuntu.
It opens a window of text to copy. Here it is.
Paste its first block into any Claude Code session: Claude installs the watcher, its hooks, the CLAUDE.md rules and the board extension.
From then on, your signals reach every session, and new sessions have the board tools.
